# Enable-ZbxHost

## SYNOPSIS

Starts monitoring hosts.

## SYNTAX

```
Enable-ZbxHost [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Enable-ZbxHost cmdlet sets the hosts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped hosts) to monitored with host.update, so the server collects their items and evaluates their triggers again. Every host the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the hosts back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Monitor a host again

```powershell
Enable-ZbxHost -InputObject 'web-01'
```

-InputObject (position 0) takes a host name, id or object.

### Example 2: Monitor every host of a group and show the result

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' | Enable-ZbxHost -PassThru | Select-Object HostName, Status
```

The piped hosts are enabled in one host.update; -PassThru writes them back with their Status.
